target.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart
target.body:
Closes #102844
Closes #102845
Closes #102846

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes issues where users completing macOS Crestodian onboarding could lose the successful setup response when the resulting config write restarted Gateway, where the documented `talk to agent` request could remain in the setup conversation, and where a named profile could import and archive default-profile approval state.

## Why This Change Was Made

All Crestodian Gateway RPC work is now registered as concurrent active work through its response, allowing restart coordination to drain accepted requests without serializing them. Exact agent navigation is handled as the existing typed host operation, while approval migrations now treat non-default profiles as an isolation boundary on both TypeScript and macOS paths; the shipped bare state-directory relocation migration remains intact.

## User Impact

The onboarding app receives setup completion before Gateway restarts, `talk to agent` reliably opens the normal agent surface, and `--profile` / `--dev` runs no longer move or archive approval files from the default profile.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kx3hfq0q8xqjgcdc7z739jv6`: `pnpm check:changed` passed (typechecks, lint, app/tooling guards; exit 0).
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kx3jg5vvesgj7cffqpv0mrw5`: final focused Gateway suite passed in both projects, 16/16 tests.
- Focused TypeScript regression set passed 165 assertions across chat, Gateway, profile guard, approvals, and state migration suites.
- Remote macOS host via Crabbox SSH lease `static_100-123-224-76`: `swift test --package-path apps/macos --filter ExecApprovalsStoreRefactorTests` passed 6/6 tests, including named-profile isolation and the existing relocation migration.
- Source-blind packaged CLI validation passed package build/install, unconfigured Gateway health, restart-safe setup response on the explicit setup control path, exact `open-agent` handoff, named-profile approval isolation, and root `--profile` config validation. The corrected first-welcome replay and authenticated post-setup agent turn are running separately on the packaged macOS build.
- Fresh structured autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
